_note: B6 no-model coverage: scripted lore creation against a real lane lorebook; review and accepted cards write only at a boundary, with a chat/group stamp; near-duplicate patch advice is rendered and the author declines. Delete the owned chat, decline its created-entry reaper, retry the deleted-chat event and accept; disk proves keep/delete. Current detection is advisory, not an acceptance refusal (plan 35 finding). Model quality and vector meaning remain separate owed gates.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (s.image.enabled || s.sprites.enabled) throw new Error('media must be off'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugCuratorResponse = 'NONE'; globalThis.__b6create = { book: 'SO-V28-35 Create Lore', sleep: (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), read: async () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const response = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-V28-35 Create Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('book read failed: ' + response.status); return Object.values((await response.json()).entries ?? {}); } }; const created = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: globalThis.__b6create.book }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!created.ok) throw new Error('fixture book create failed: ' + created.message); return { mediaOff: true, bookCreated: true };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const b = globalThis.__b6create; if (rt.getExtractionFacts().filter((f) => f.text.includes('copper beacon')).length < 2) throw new Error('two established facts missing'); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: true }); const out = await rt.runLoreCreatePass('b6-create', '[create] SO-V28-35 Create Lore || Copper beacon || copper beacon || The copper beacon stands in the square and rings at noon.'); const op = out.record?.ops.find((e) => e.op.kind === 'create'); if (!op || op.status !== 'pending') throw new Error('create did not wait for review: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); b.card = { id: out.record.id, index: out.record.ops.indexOf(op) }; if ((await b.read()).some((e) => e.comment === 'Copper beacon')) throw new Error('proposal wrote before acceptance'); await rt.setCuratorOpDecision(b.card.id, b.card.index, 'accepted'); if ((await b.read()).some((e) => e.comment === 'Copper beacon')) throw new Error('acceptance wrote before boundary'); return { pendingBeforeAcceptance: true, acceptedBeforeBoundary: true };

[]).length !== 1) throw new Error('created ledger not exactly one'); b.written = JSON.stringify(entry); return { boundaryWrite: true, stampPresent: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const out = await rt.runLoreCreatePass('b6-duplicate', '[create] SO-V28-35 Create Lore || Copper beacon record || copper beacon || The copper beacon stands in the square and rings at noon.'); const op = out.record?.ops.find((e) => e.op.kind === 'create'); if (!op || !op.nearDups?.length) throw new Error('near-duplicate comparison was not exercised: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); globalThis.__b6create.duplicate = { id: out.record.id, index: out.record.ops.indexOf(op) }; return { nearDuplicates: op.nearDups.length };

const b = globalThis.__b6create; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.setCuratorOpDecision(b.duplicate.id, b.duplicate.index, 'rejected'); const live = rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.find((p) => p.id === b.duplicate.id).ops[b.duplicate.index]; if (live.status !== 'rejected') throw new Error('author decline failed'); if ((await b.read()).some((e) => e.comment === 'Copper beacon record')) throw new Error('declined duplicate reached disk'); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: false }); return { declined: true };
const b = globalThis.__b6create; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); b.chat = ctx.chatId; b.group = ctx.groupId; await b.sleep(3000); return { ownedChatRecorded: true };

const b = globalThis.__b6create; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.chatId === b.chat || ctx.groupId !== b.group) throw new Error('new chat did not stay in the pinned group'); const groups = await import('/scripts/group-chats.js'); await groups.deleteGroupChat(b.group, b.chat, { jumpToNewChat: false }); const until = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < until) { const created = document.querySelector('[data-so-reap-kind=created]'); if (created) return { deletedChat: true, createdQuestion: true }; const mirror = document.querySelector('[data-so-reap-chat]'); if (mirror) mirror.closest('dialog').querySelector('.popup-button-cancel').click(); await b.sleep(100); } throw new Error('created-entry reaper did not ask after deletion');
